scripts.dev:api: mkdir -p dist && wrangler d1 migrations apply baalpeh --local && wrangler dev --port 8787
scripts.preview:worker: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply baalpeh --local && wrangler dev --port 8787 --var APP_ORIGIN:http://localhost:8787
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p worker/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p sw/tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply baalpeh --remote && wrangler deploy
